next_minimal_slice.anti_shortcut: Do not add representability, universality, consistency, or a proof predicate as an unproved constructor/postulate.
next_minimal_slice.goal: Choose or extend one exact target syntax with Nat and a finite derivation representation, then machine-check one end-to-end encoded derivation and a negative control.

non_goals: The matrix does not prove that the missing obligations are impossible.
The R3 theorem is not thereby instantiated to HoTT.
Host-language definability is not object-language representability.
No HoTT paradox, internal inconsistency, novelty, or reality-relative witness is claimed.

obligations.missing_scope: Nat, general object identity/Path, object univalence/HIT, and a single complete raw HoTT calculus.
obligations.present_scope: Four-sort Con/Sub/Ty/Tm Cubical HIIT syntax with terminal context, context extension, U/El, Pi, lambda/app, beta/eta, truncation constructors and second-order coherence.

obligations.missing_scope: No total executable conversion or derivation checker for the exact quotient/HIIT object syntax has been constructed.
obligations.present_scope: The HIIT syntax carries judgmental/path equations and coherence constructors.

obligations.missing_scope: Nat formation, zero, successor, eliminator, computation rules, addition/multiplication and coding arithmetic.
obligations.present_scope: No Nat constructor occurs in the frozen TT syntax module denominator.

obligations.missing_scope: A general identity/Path type former and its formation/introduction/elimination/computation rules inside the object calculus.
obligations.present_scope: Cubical paths are used by the host to define the HIIT and prove coherence.

obligations.missing_scope: Object-level univalence and named higher-inductive type rules in the exact calculus.
obligations.present_scope: U/El and the syntax HIIT itself are present at the host/formalisation level.

obligations.missing_scope: Natural-number code, decoder, total checker and fair proof enumeration for derivations of the same HoTT calculus named by H-SYNTAX.
obligations.present_scope: C-157-C-187 provide proof/formula coding for a separate small K/S/MP system.

obligations.missing_scope: An executable capture-avoiding formula substitution operation on a proof-coded arithmetic/HoTT language suitable for diagonalisation.
obligations.present_scope: The groupoid syntax has typed substitutions, composition, identity, action on types/terms, and second-order coherence.

obligations.missing_scope: A machine-checked interpretation of Q or another sufficient arithmetic theory into the exact H-SYNTAX calculus.
obligations.present_scope: R3 Coq source formalises Robinson Q and its standard first-order arithmetic infrastructure.

obligations.missing_scope: Object-level strong representation of the HoTT proof predicate, coding and substitution functions in the target calculus.
obligations.present_scope: C-246 assumes strong separation; the author R3 development proves it for its first-order arithmetic route.

obligations.missing_scope: A fixed-point/diagonal lemma whose quotation and substitution operate on the exact target HoTT derivation syntax.
obligations.present_scope: The R3 package contains the recursive-separation/diagonal mechanism for its source theory.

obligations.missing_scope: An independent sentence theorem with the target T instantiated to the exact HoTT calculus and every premise discharged or retained explicitly.
obligations.present_scope: C-246 and C-248 establish conditional independence in general formal systems and Robinson-Q extensions.

obligations.missing_scope: Effective enumeration of the exact target rule/axiom schemas and proof relation, including the status of univalence, HIT, resizing, quotient or oracle rules.
obligations.present_scope: The R3 source theory assumes/proves enumerability in its own first-order setting; finite host source files type-check.

source_theory.scope: Conditional general essential incompleteness and Robinson-Q independence in first-order arithmetic.

target_calculus.scope: Exact Pi/U/El four-sort groupoid syntax slice, not a complete HoTT calculus.
